pokedexEntries.su: It feeds on the nectar and pollen of flowers. Because it’s able to sense auras, it can identify which flowers are about to bloom.

pokedexEntries.mo: Myriads of Cutiefly flutter above the heads of people who have auras resembling those of flowers.

pokedexEntries.us: Nectar and pollen are its favorite fare. In fields of flowers, it gets into skirmishes with Butterfree over food.

pokedexEntries.um: Cutiefly can pick up the auras of living things. It skillfully reads those auras to predict its foes’ movements and make fools of them.

pokedexEntries.sw: Nectar and pollen are its favorite fare. You can find Cutiefly hovering around Gossifleur, trying to get some of Gossifleur’s pollen.

pokedexEntries.sh: An opponent’s aura can tell Cutiefly what that opponent’s next move will be. Then Cutiefly can glide around the attack and strike back.

pokedexEntries.sc: When it senses the auras of people or Pokémon who are having fun, it will draw close and give them a painful poke with its long proboscis.

pokedexEntries.vi: Cutiefly sucks up pollen and nectar with its long proboscis. It stores any pollen it doesn't finish eating in its fur.
